notes.title: Update to Version2.0, Full Local Deployment AI chat model and high-quality TTS
notes.content:
New Support:
• Add Support DeepSeek R1,and with "Think" part skip during TTS.
• Add GPT-SoVITS2 Modified Optimized Edition:

 3-second voice cloning for custom voice creation and support  Steam Workshop.
 GPU acceleration (NVIDIA cards) for near-instant (<1s) text-to-speech.
 Fully local deployment and offline running 

• Add FastTTS Millisecond-Level TTS Engine:

 Supports Kokoro and 800+ anime characters voicebanks.
 Genuine English accent voice models.
 NVIDIA GPU acceleration for ultra-fast real-time TTS.
 Seconds-level response even on CPU-only systems.
 Fully local deployment and offline running 

• TurboKokoro Multilingual Engine:

 Supported languages: Chinese, Japanese, English, French, Hindi, Italian, Portuguese, Spanish.
 54 built-in vocalists.
 Super-fast speed and natural pronunciation.
 Fully local deployment and offline running 


Performance Improvements:
• Reduced rendering compatibility issues.
• Fixed character rendering issues.

UI Enhancements:
• Added right-bottom progress indicator for local LLM/TTS Engine loading.
• Click "Details" to view voice engine logs.

Deprecation:
• Removed SuperVITS support; automatically replaced by GPT-SoVITS2.

notes.content:
